Man Shot Dead Near Ulhasnagar Railway Station

A man was shot dead near Ulhasnagar Railway Station in Thane, Maharashtra. He was reportedly shot twice in the head. The attackers fled the scene and are currently being sought by authorities. Old rivalry is suspected as a motive.
